name: Short Course - Legacy Reinstatement
description: POST/re-POST via the legacy 2025/26 route (no academicYear querystring); DELETE via the new-style 2026/27 route (academicYear=2627)
extraDescription: Confirms mixing route styles within one lifecycle works: POST and the reinstating re-POST use the legacy /providers/{ukprn}/shortCourses route, while the DELETE in between uses the new-style /providers/{ukprn}/shortCourses/{learnerKey}?academicYear=2627 route. When reinstated, the 30% milestone is claimed at the same time, which it wasn't previously.

steps.name: SLD Deletes the Short Course — new-style URI with academicYear=2627
